title: Composition of scalar extensions
statement:
Let $E\subset L\subset M$ be finite extensions of $\Ql$ and let $Y$ be a
scheme. For every object $K$ of the rationalized category $D^b_c(Y,E)$ of
[def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] there is a canonical isomorphism

$$
 (K\otimes_EL)\otimes_LM\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }K\otimes_EM
$$

in $D^b_c(Y,M)$, natural in $K$ and compatible with the identity extension;
that is, the scalar-extension functors of
[def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] are compatible with composition of finite
extensions.

proof.text: Restrict the globally normalized scalarCompletion natural transformation to the intrinsic integral subcategory. Its derived-completeness clause makes every component invertible. To prove uniqueness from the good-complex equation, choose a K-flat resolution with flat terms of any derived object, cancel the completed representative comparison there, and transport equality along the resolution isomorphism using naturality. This constructs exactly sfIntegralOrdinaryComparison, without any finite-field structure on Y.

proof.text: Use the existing uniquely tensor-normalized ordinary sheaf associator and multiplication unit. Fully faithful cancellation of the intrinsic full-subcategory inclusions lifts their conjugates by sfIntegralOrdinaryComparison, with exactly the stated component equations. Generic fully faithful cancellation proves existence and uniqueness of both lifts. Construct the rational isomorphisms from the given component equations by tensor induction on Hom groups; no new objects or retracts are introduced.

source.place: Proof, first paragraph (integral representatives and tensor associativity)

proof.text: For any integral derived morphism $f$, naturality proved for roofs in Step 2 gives $c_{K'_0}\circ((f\otimes1)\otimes1)=(f\otimes1)\circ c_{K_0}$. For a chain-map representative both sides send $((p\otimes s)\otimes u)$ to $f(p)\otimes su$; the roof argument supplies the equality for arbitrary $f$. The comparison is linear over the final completed coefficient sheaf, hence in particular over $\mathcal O_E$. By [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], a rational morphism is a finite sum of $f\otimes a$ with $a\in E$. The two composite scalar-extension functors send it respectively to $((f\otimes1)\otimes1)\otimes a$ and $(f\otimes1)\otimes a$ in the final rationalized Hom group over $M$. Tensor the displayed integral naturality equation by $a$ and add. Therefore the image of the integral comparison is a natural isomorphism on the actual rationalized categories, with inverse the image of the integral inverse. This constructs the displayed isomorphism for every $K$.

Check the inverse ordinary associator and unit on 1 tensor x. The prescribed hom formulas and inverse equations force the inverse associator to send c tensor x to c tensor (1 tensor x), and the inverse unit to send x to 1 tensor x. The universal property of sheafified scalar extension makes these generators detect equality. Both unit equations and the pentagon now follow on generators. The existing mapDerivedCategoryCompIso unit and associativity equations, and naturality of mapDerivedCategoryNatIso under whiskering, transport the laws to the ordinary derived functors. Expand the normalized integral lifts. Naturality moves each intermediate comparison through scalar extension and adjacent inverse comparisons cancel, so full-subcategory faithfulness gives integral coherence. Finally the published rational scalar functors map localized integral arrows to the localized integral images; HEq transports the specified object equalities. Applying localization to the integral laws and preserving composition proves both rational unit equations and the pentagon.
